title: DriftAway Valance Watercolor Checker Plaid
text: DriftAway Valance Watercolor Checker Plaid. For me I didn’t like it when sent to me. Looked nice on Amazon though. Pattern was way to big , something I would not put up in my kitchen area.

product_metadata.title: DriftAway Diamond Trellis Watercolor Geometric Checker Plaid Pattern Blackout Thermal Insulated Energy Saving Window Curtain Valance Rod Pocket Single 52 Inch by 18 Inch Plus 2 Inch Header Navy
features: PACKAGE INCLUDE: One valance. Extremely soft to the touch. Made of 100% Polyester, imported.

DESIGN & STYLE: The artistic geometric patterns are as real as those drawn with a water color brush, looks very soft and natural. This geometric print design with its visually clean lines and fashionable color matching gives the curtain a modern twist from a soft & simple look. Background color is soft white. This unlined versatile valance provides an easy and inexpensive way to add color and style to any room of your home.

UPGRADED VERSION & SERVE WELL: This valance is upgraded and beyond normal one, innovated soft and smooth material, match your any customized home styles, fit well fort traditional, modern, glamour, shabby chic or farmhouse home decor. Perfect for your living room, bedroom, beach house, dining room, kitchen, bathroom, girls' room, nursery, or any other window space that could use that perfect finishing touch.
SIZE & HEADER TYPE: 52”W X 18”L+2”HEADER. 3” Rod Pocket slides easily onto your curtain rod for quick installation.
CARE INSTRUCTION: Machine Wash Cold, Gentle Cycle in mesh bag, only non-chlorine bleach when needed, tumble dry low, cool iron if needed.
